## Summary
Extract speaker notes from parsed lecture sections and create separate SpeakerNote nodes in Supabase and Neo4j, enforcing AP-11 (speaker notes NEVER in ContentChunks).

## User story
As a faculty member, I want my speaker notes to be captured separately from slide content, so that the knowledge graph preserves the distinction between presentation content and teaching commentary.

## Why this matters
AP-11 is a canonical antipattern: speaker notes mixed into ContentChunks contaminate the embedding space with informal commentary ("remember to mention...", "ask students about..."). This degrades retrieval quality for entity extraction and TEACHES edge creation. Speaker notes must be stored as their own node type.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] SpeakerNote rows created in Supabase for each section with has_speaker_notes=true
- [ ] SpeakerNote nodes created in Neo4j via neo4jQuery with: uuid, lecture_section_id, text
- [ ] HAS_SPEAKER_NOTE edge created: LectureSection → SpeakerNote
- [ ] Supabase written FIRST, Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
- [ ] Speaker notes text is NEVER appended to LectureSection.raw_text (AP-11)
- [ ] Speaker notes text is NEVER included in downstream ContentChunk creation (AP-11)
- [ ] Empty speaker notes (whitespace only) are skipped — no SpeakerNote node created
- [ ] speaker_notes_raw column cleared from lecture_sections after extraction (cleanup)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for SpeakerNote node creation and edge to LectureSection |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Write SpeakerNote to Supabase FIRST, then Neo4j node + edge |
| AP-11 | Speaker notes NEVER in ContentChunks — this story enforces the boundary |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- speaker_notes table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speaker_notes (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  lecture_section_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lecture_sections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  neo4j_synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  neo4j_sync_status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p1-steps/speaker-notes.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

export async function extractSpeakerNotes(
  sections: LectureSection[],
  institutionId: string
) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()
  const sectionsWithNotes = sections.filter(
    s => s.has_speaker_notes && s.speaker_notes_raw?.trim()
  )

  // 1. Write SpeakerNote rows to Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
  const noteRows = sectionsWithNotes.map(s => ({
    lecture_section_id: s.id,
    text: s.speaker_notes_raw!.trim(),
  }))

  const { data: notes, error } = await supabase
    .from('speaker_notes')
    .insert(noteRows)
    .select()

  if (error) throw error

  // 2. Create Neo4j nodes SECOND (Rule 6)
  await Promise.allSettled(
    notes.map(note =>
      neo4jQuery(institutionId, `
        MERGE (sn:SpeakerNote { uuid: $uuid })
        SET sn.lecture_section_id = $sectionId
        WITH sn
        MATCH (ls:LectureSection { uuid: $sectionId })
        MERGE (ls)-[:HAS_SPEAKER_NOTE]->(sn)
      `, { uuid: note.id, sectionId: note.lecture_section_id })
    )
  )

  // 3. Clean up raw speaker notes from lecture_sections
  await supabase
    .from('lecture_sections')
    .update({ speaker_notes_raw: null })
    .in('id', sectionsWithNotes.map(s => s.id))

  return notes
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-11: Speaker notes in ContentChunks — NEVER do this
const chunkText = section.raw_text + '\n' + section.speaker_notes_raw
await createContentChunk(chunkText) // WRONG — contaminates embedding space

// ✗ AP-01: Raw neo4j-driver import
import { driver } from 'neo4j-driver'

// ✗ Rule 6: Neo4j before Supabase
await neo4jQuery(institutionId, 'CREATE (sn:SpeakerNote ...)')
await supabase.from('speaker_notes').insert(...)  // WRONG ORDER
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S04.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

test.describe('E03-S04: Speaker notes → SpeakerNote nodes', () => {
  test('SpeakerNote rows created for sections with speaker notes', async ({ request }) => {
    // Pre-condition: lecture with speaker notes must exist from E03-S02
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/speaker-notes`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      expect(data.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
      for (const note of data) {
        expect(note.text).toBeTruthy()
        expect(note.text.trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
        expect(note.lecture_section_id).toBeTruthy()
      }
    }
  })

  test('AP-11: Speaker notes are NOT in ContentChunk text', async ({ request }) => {
    // After the full pipeline runs, verify no ContentChunk contains speaker note text
    const notesRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/speaker-notes`
    )
    const chunksRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/chunks`
    )
    if (notesRes.ok() && chunksRes.ok()) {
      const { data: notes } = await notesRes.json()
      const { data: chunks } = await chunksRes.json()
      for (const note of notes) {
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          // No chunk should contain the full speaker note text
          expect(chunk.text).not.toContain(note.text)
        }
      }
    }
  })

  test('Empty speaker notes do not create SpeakerNote nodes', async ({ request }) => {
    // Sections with empty/whitespace-only speaker notes should be skipped
    const res = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/sections`
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      const emptySpeakerSections = data.filter(
        (s: any) => s.has_speaker_notes && !s.speaker_notes_raw?.trim()
      )
      // These should have no corresponding SpeakerNote
      for (const section of emptySpeakerSections) {
        const noteRes = await request.get(
          `${API_BASE}/api/speaker-notes?section_id=${section.id}`
        )
        if (noteRes.ok()) {
          const { data: notes } = await noteRes.json()
          expect(notes.length).toBe(0)
        }
      }
    }
  })
})
```
